# Stanmere Bottled Gas - depot office

Cylinders leave on one of two terms. Customers who come to the depot pay the
collection charge and the run charges the yard delivery rate; the terms are
agreed when the order is taken.

turns.prompt: Priory Road Allotments have ordered twenty-four propane cylinders and want the carriage on the invoice. What do I put down for them?

They are collecting from the depot themselves. What is the carriage on twenty-four propane cylinders collected from the depot? Give the number alone, as digits, with nothing after it. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
